result.summary: Found 1 significant visual layout issue: the restaurant metadata beneath Tokumaru Ramen Bar is visibly overlapping and difficult to read.

issues.description: The metadata row below “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” has overlapping text: the delivery-time text and “delivery” appear on top of each other, with the cuisine label also crowded on the same line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata layout by using consistent spacing and alignment between delivery time, delivery fee, separator, and cuisine; allow the row to wrap cleanly if needed.
